meta.name: spark-optimization
meta.description: Optimize Apache Spark jobs with partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and memory tuning. Use when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.

copy.tagline: 优化大数据处理作业的性能与资源占用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的数据作业常因Spark性能问题而卡顿或烧钱。
copy.tagline_en: Speed up Spark jobs and lower resource usage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Spark pipelines and often face slow jobs or high resource bills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Spark 优化套路改写你的作业:调整分区、缓存、shuffle 与内存参数,排查慢任务和数据倾斜,并给出可直接用的配置与代码示例。
howto.when: 当你提到 Spark 作业变慢、需要调内存或 executor 配置,或要排查数据倾斜等问题时,它会接管。

say.text: 我的 Spark 作业跑得很慢,帮我看看怎么优化
say.note: 它会从分区、shuffle、内存几处给建议

say.text: 帮我写一个开了 AQE 和 Kryo 序列化的 SparkSession 配置
say.note: 会输出带这些参数的建会话代码

say.text: 这个 join 有明显数据倾斜,怎么改
say.note: 会给出 salting 或广播 join 的写法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude rewrites your Spark jobs with optimization patterns: sizing partitions, caching, shuffle and memory settings, debugging slow tasks and data skew, and giving ready-to-use config and code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say a Spark job is slow, want to tune memory or executor configs, or need to debug data skew.

say_en.text: My Spark job is slow, help me optimize it
say_en.note: Suggests fixes for partitions, shuffle, memory

say_en.text: Write a SparkSession config with AQE and Kryo serialization
say_en.note: Outputs session builder code with those settings

say_en.text: This join has heavy data skew, how do I fix it
say_en.note: Offers salting or broadcast join patterns
